items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Do you remember Farmer George? Fireman George?

ctx.x: Oh yeah, they were all good places. I know that Burren and Biennale where you used to play was tough.

Yeah, that was rough there. Where was that? What's that? In the district. In the district there. What was the name of that place? They had a whole fella, they had that place, they called him Papa. Papa's place. I know what I'm going to ask you. Do you remember Farmer
George? Fireman George? He used to have a parade with one colored fireman here, and he'd go out and have a parade himself by himself. Nobody else, just him.
